title: Why

split.short: Sessions under 30 min: the whole body every time.

splitReplaced: Not enough equipment for a {{template}} session: it is replaced by full body.

goal.muscle: Muscle gain: sets of 6 to 12 reps, 90 to 120 s of rest.
goal.recomposition: Recomposition: sets of 8 to 15 reps, 60 to 90 s of rest, with circuits and a finisher.
goal.general-fitness: General fitness: 2 to 3 sets of 10 to 15 reps, 45 to 75 s of rest, more cardio and core work.

level.beginner: Beginner: one set fewer, more margin on every set and easier variations.
level.returning: Returning: a beginner’s volume, with an intermediate’s choice of exercises.
level.advanced: Advanced: one extra set and harder variations.

ranked: The best ranked for the “{{pattern}}” movement with your equipment and level.
easierFrom: Easier version of {{from}}, for your level.
harderFrom: Harder version of {{from}}, for your level.
upgraded: Moved up to a harder version after your last cycle. Before: {{from}}.
kept: Kept from your last cycle: you keep building on it.
fallback: Your equipment doesn’t allow the usual movement ({{wanted}}): this one comes close.
slotDropped: No {{patterns}} exercise: your equipment doesn’t allow it, so the slot is removed.
loadStart: Starting load: {{kg}} kg, about {{pct}}% of your bodyweight, rounded down to the weights you own.
loadStartAssumed: Bodyweight not set: the calculation starts from {{bodyweight}} kg. Week 1 is for adjusting.
loadBand: {{band}} to start, based on your level.
loadUnloaded: No added weight for now: it comes once you reach the top of the range with clean reps.
rampUp: Ramp-up sets before the first heavy set, building up to {{kg}} kg.
finisherSkipped: No conditioning finisher: it doesn’t serve your goal.
cardioModality: {{modality}}: the cardio that fits your equipment best.
cardioUnavailable: No cardio is possible with your equipment: it is removed.
balanceAdded: One set added on {{name}} to balance pushing and pulling.
balanceRemoved: One set removed on {{name}} to balance pushing and pulling.

timeFit.block-added: One exercise added to fill your {{budget}} min.
timeFit.block-dropped: One exercise removed to fit your {{budget}} min.
timeFit.finisher-dropped: Finisher removed to fit your {{budget}} min.
timeFit.finisher-lengthened: Finisher lengthened to fill your {{budget}} min.
timeFit.finisher-shortened: Finisher shortened to fit your {{budget}} min.
timeFit.rests-shortened: Rests shortened by {{seconds}} s to fit your {{budget}} min.
timeFit.round-added: One round added to fill your {{budget}} min.
timeFit.rounds-trimmed: One round removed to fit your {{budget}} min.
timeFit.set-added: One set added to fill your {{budget}} min.
timeFit.sets-trimmed: One set removed to fit your {{budget}} min.
timeFit.warmup-shortened: Warm-up shortened to fit your {{budget}} min.

maxTest: A max test of {{name}} closes the cycle to measure your progress.
quick: A {{minutes}} min session, {{focus}}: no progression, not saved until you start it.
